title.zh: 先固定能使用坐标展开的代数条件
title.en: Fix the hypotheses for the chart expansion

given.zh: A、R、k、K 满足原声明中的代数塔、局部同态、形式无分歧、有限型与形式 étale 条件；σ 有限，且每个 aᵢ > 0。
given.en: A, R, k and K satisfy the declared algebra towers, local-map, formally unramified, essentially finite-type and formally étale conditions; σ is finite and every aᵢ > 0.

claim.zh: 要研究的是函数族 w ↦ (x ↦ closedChartFieldRetraction w x)，参数取归一化截面 ∑ᵢ aᵢwᵢ = 1，并保留上述坐标图假设。
claim.en: The family is w ↦ (x ↦ closedChartFieldRetraction w x), restricted to ∑ᵢ aᵢwᵢ = 1; all the chart hypotheses remain part of the assertion.

reason.zh: 把题设的局部代数和形式 étale 条件代入 closedChartExpansion_injective；后面延拓到 K 时正是用这份单射性排除非零元具有无限赋值。
reason.en: Apply closedChartExpansion_injective with the declared local-algebra and formally étale hypotheses. This injectivity makes the valuation finite on nonzero elements before extension to K.

reason.zh: 各项 aᵢwᵢ 都非负，所以每项不超过总和 1；再用 aᵢ>0 除过去。这说明为什么严格正的归一化系数能限制每个权重。
reason.en: Every term aᵢwᵢ is nonnegative and therefore at most the sum, one. Divide by aᵢ>0. This explains why strict positivity bounds every coordinate.

statement.en: The target is compactness of F(Wₐ), where F(w)(x)=closedChartFieldRetraction(w)(x).

reason.zh: 目标里的双函数依次取权重和分式域元素；把它看作函数空间中的映射，下一步就能使用“紧致集的连续像紧致”。
reason.en: The two function arguments are a weight and then a fraction-field element. Reading this as a map into a function space prepares the compact-image argument.

title.zh: 把单射坐标展开代入紧致性引理
title.en: Apply compactness to the injective coordinate expansion

given.zh: 取 θ = closedChartExpansion : A →ₐ[k] k⟦σ⟧，并使用已导入的 closedChartExpansion_injective。
given.en: Take θ = closedChartExpansion : A →ₐ[k] k⟦σ⟧ and the imported proof closedChartExpansion_injective.

claim.zh: 一般引理给出 {x ↦ expandedFractionValuation θ hθ w x : w ∈ normalizedWeights a} 紧致。
claim.en: The general lemma yields compactness of {x ↦ expandedFractionValuation θ hθ w x : w ∈ normalizedWeights a}.

statement.zh: Wₐ 是有限盒 ∏ᵢ[0,1/aᵢ] 中的闭集，因此紧致。
statement.en: Wₐ is a closed subset of the finite box ∏ᵢ[0,1/aᵢ], hence compact.

reason.zh: 坐标上界来自前一步；w↦Σᵢaᵢwᵢ 连续，所以取值为 1 的截面闭。有限个闭有界区间的乘积紧致，闭子集仍紧致。
reason.en: The previous step bounds each coordinate. The continuous map w↦Σᵢaᵢwᵢ has a closed level set at one. A finite product of compact intervals is compact, as is its closed subset.

statement.zh: 对非零 p∈A，v_w(p)=min_{d∈Tₚ}Σᵢwᵢdᵢ，其中 Tₚ 有限。
statement.en: For nonzero p∈A, v_w(p)=min_{d∈Tₚ}Σᵢwᵢdᵢ for a finite set Tₚ.

reason.zh: 库证明从 θ(p) 的支撑选出有限子集，使每个支撑指数都逐项大于等于其中某个指数。因 wᵢ≥0，剩余指数的权重不可能更小；有限个连续线性权重的最小值仍连续。
reason.en: The library selects a finite subset of the support of θ(p) such that every support exponent is at least one selected exponent in each coordinate. Nonnegative weights make the remaining weights no smaller; a finite minimum of continuous linear weights is continuous.

statement.en: For x=p/q≠0, V_w(x)=v_w(p)−v_w(q), with both values finite.

reason.zh: q 可取非零，x≠0 又使 p≠0；单射 θ 使拉回赋值在这两个元素上有限。因此这里相减的是实数。
reason.en: Choose q≠0; then x≠0 implies p≠0. Injectivity of θ makes the pulled-back values finite, so the subtraction is between real numbers.

statement.zh: w↦V_w(x) 对每个 x∈K 连续；x=0 时恒为 ⊤。
statement.en: For each x∈K, w↦V_w(x) is continuous; for x=0 it is constantly ⊤.

reason.zh: 非零分式使用前一行的两个连续实函数之差；零分式单独使用常函数。逐点评价拓扑下，各坐标连续就给出整个函数族连续。
reason.en: For a nonzero fraction use the difference of two continuous real functions; handle zero as a constant function. Coordinatewise continuity gives continuity in the pointwise topology.

statement.en: Compactness of Wₐ implies compactness of {V_w:w∈Wₐ}.

reason.zh: 被调用的 isCompact_expandedFractionValuation_cone 正是把归一化截面的紧致性与这个连续映射相接，随后对 θ 和 hθ 实例化。
reason.en: The invoked isCompact_expandedFractionValuation_cone takes the continuous image of the compact normalized section, instantiated at θ and hθ.

title.zh: 展开三个定义，得到原结论
title.en: Unfold three definitions to obtain the target

given.zh: 上一步已得到展开赋值在分式域 K 上的紧致函数族。
given.en: The preceding step gives a compact family of expanded valuations on K.

claim.zh: 这恰好是 {x ↦ closedChartFieldRetraction w x : w ∈ normalizedWeights a}，因此目标中的 IsCompact 成立。
claim.en: This is exactly {x ↦ closedChartFieldRetraction w x : w ∈ normalizedWeights a}, so the required IsCompact statement follows.

reason.zh: 展开局部回缩的定义后，就是沿选定坐标展开 θ 拉回的单项式赋值；参数 w 没有发生变换。
reason.en: Unfolding the local retraction gives the monomial valuation pulled back along θ, with the same weight w.

reason.zh: 两者再用同一个 fractionValuation 将上一行的局部赋值延拓到 K。最终的 simpa only 只展开这三个定义。
reason.en: Both apply the same fractionValuation construction to extend that local valuation to K. The final simpa only unfolds precisely these definitions.

reason.zh: 逐点相等使两组像集相同，因此上一步的紧致集就是原目标中的集合。
reason.en: Pointwise equality identifies the image sets, so the compact set from the preceding step is exactly the set in the target.
